query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM publish_jobs
                   WHERE owner_id = $1 AND status IN ('scheduled', 'publishing')
                     AND jsonb_path_exists(
                         content_snapshot,
                         '$.variants[*].media[*].asset ? (@ == $asset)',
                         jsonb_build_object('asset', $2::text))
               ) AS "frozen!"
